ownerScope: Require an active signed-in account for Share/export and viewing shared browser reports.
behavior: Current and legacy shared report pages authenticate before report data, metadata or development fixtures are loaded.
Login preserves the report route and query parameters; the existing login form supports account creation and returns to the requested destination.
Browser report endpoints require a validated session before exports, report details, screenshots, form snapshots, relationship graphs or full-site reads.
Share menu opening, copying, email and download actions recheck the session. The email server action independently authenticates before transport or report work.
Report access and login bypass the signed session-cookie cache to reject revoked sessions without a login redirect loop.
Report details use private, no-store responses. Existing workspace ownership and PDF eligibility checks remain in place.
preserved: Existing API and MCP authorization contracts
Account creation eligibility and access allowlists

cost.basis: Bounded session lookups only; no new capture, model calls, retention or provisioned infrastructure. Anonymous requests stop before report work.

validation.routeIsolationProof: Actual route handlers and actual access guard return 401/private-no-store for missing validated sessions, including forged cookie and bearer input. Data/export dependencies throw if reached.
validation.webTypecheck: Blocked only by existing optional-string errors in cms-security-projection.test.ts, lines 384-392; no errors reported in changed access files.
validation.localHttp: Anonymous shared report redirected to login with its requested report and review focus preserved. Broader live endpoint checks were interrupted when the development server disconnected; route isolation checks passed.
